x-e-h2-10.title: Ololihii dib-u-warshadaynta ma shaqeeyey? Dib u fikirka mar kasta oo xog cusub timaaddo
x-e-h2-10.topic: dib u eegista xukun xog cusub
x-e-h2-10.goal: Eeg xogta lagu sii daayey saddex toddobaad, dib u eeg xukunkaaga mar kasta, oo sharax Ingiriisi xogtee ayaa beddeshay xukunkaaga.
x-e-h2-10.material: Dugsi ayaa bilaabay olole dib-u-warshadayn dhalooyinka balaastigga ah. Ololaha ka hor, celcelis 120 dhalo maalintii ayaa galay qashin-qubka guud, 10-na waxay galeen qashin-qubka dib-u-warshadaynta. Su'aashu waa, 'Ololihii ma shaqeeyey?' Waxaad eegi doontaa xogta hal toddobaad mar.
x-e-h2-10.thinking.0: Dib u eegista xukun iyadoo la raacayo xog cusub
x-e-h2-10.prereq.0: Akhrinta isbarbar dhig ka hor iyo kadib
x-e-h2-10.prereq.1: Tibaaxaha waqtiga sida at first iyo later
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.prompt: Akhri xogta cusub toddobaad kasta oo go'aami xukunkaaga ilaa hadda.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.hint.0: Hel hal tiro ama dhacdo cusub xogta toddobaadkan.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi mid mid haddii xukunkaagii hore ku habboon yahay xogta cusub.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Toddobaadka 1: Dhalooyinka qashinka maalintii ee qashin-qubka guud ayaa ka dhaceen 120 ilaa 80.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Xogta Toddobaadka 1 oo keliya eegaya, xukunkee ayaa ku habboon?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Waa run in dhalooyinku yaraadeen Toddobaadka 1. Xilligan, waa macquul in loo arko 'wuu shaqeeyey' iyo in la yidhaahdo 'waa hal toddobaad oo keliya, aan sii daawanno.'
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Xukunkani wuxuu ku salaysan yahay xaqiiqada ah tirada way yaraatay. Sidoo kale ka fikir xadka ah waa hal toddobaad oo xog ah.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kani waa xukun taxaddar leh oo ku salaysan caddayn, oo dib u dhigaya gabagabo adag sababtoo ah waa hal toddobaad oo xog ah.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waa run in 80 ay hadhaan, laakiin sidee u sharaxaysaa in tirada ay ka dhacday 120?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Toddobaadka 2: Safar dugsi ayaa 100 ka mid ah 400 arday ka qaaday Arbacada ilaa Jimcaha. Dhalooyinka qashinka maalintii: 70.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sidee ayaad dib u eegi lahayd xukunkaaga kadib aragtida macluumaadka cusub?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Maadaama tirada ardaydu ay hoos u dhacday rubuc, lama kala saari karo haddii dhalooyinku hoos u dhaceen ololaha awgiis mise sababtoo ah arday yar ayaa jirtay. Hoos u dhigidda kalsoonidaada waa ku habboon.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Haddii dhalooyinku hoos u dhaceen toddobaad ay arday yar jirtay, hubi haddii ololuhu yahay sabab keliya ee hoos u dhaca.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Xukunkani sidoo kale wuxuu tixgeliyaa sharaxaad kale, isbeddelka tirada ardayda.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Haddii 100 arday ay maqan yihiin, dhalooyin yar ayaa sidoo kale la tuuri karaa. Hubi haddii tani tahay macluumaad aad iska indho tiri karto.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Toddobaadka 3: Dhammaan ardaydu way soo noqdeen. Dhalooyinka qashinka maalintii: 75. Qashin-qubka dib-u-warshadaynta hadda wuxuu haystaa 60 dhalo maalintii (wuxuu haystay 10 maalintii ololaha ka hor).
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.ask: Xukunkee ayaa ugu taageersan kadib aragtida xogta ugu dambeysa?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Qashinka 75 + dib-u-warshadaynta 60 = 135, taas oo ku dhawaad la mid ah 120 + 10 = 130 ka hor ololaha. Tirada dhalooyinka ma hoos u dhicin, laakiin u wareejinta qashin-qubka dib-u-warshadaynta waa saameynta ololaha.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Xukunkani wuxuu eegay xaqiiqada ah tiradu u dhow ma aha 0 oo keliya. Sidee u akhrisaa tirada qashin-qubka dib-u-warshadaynta?
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Haddii aad eegto qashin-qubka oo keliya, tiradu way hoos u dhacday, laakiin isbarbar dhig wadarta oo ay ku jirto qashin-qubka dib-u-warshadaynta (75+60 iyo 120+10).
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kani waa xukun isbarbar dhigaya wadarta qashin-qubka iyo qashin-qubka dib-u-warshadaynta wadajir.
x-e-h2-10.s.s1.reflect: Sidee xukunkaagu u beddelmay toddobaad ilaa toddobaad? Haddii uu beddelmay, magacaw hal xog (hal weedh) oo keentay.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.prompt: Qor 2 ilaa 3 weedhood Ingiriisi ah oo ku saabsan sida xukunkaagu u beddelmay. Sheeg xogta toddobaadkee ayaa beddeshay maskaxdaada.
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.hint.0: Qor hal xariiq doorashada aad dooratay toddobaad kasta, oo calaamadee halka ay beddelmeen.

x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma arki kartaa xukunkaaga koowaad, sababta aad dhexda ugu gariirtay, iyo xukunkaaga ugu dambeeya?
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Xukunkaaga ugu dambeeya ma ku taageersan yahay tirooyinka xogta Toddobaadka 3?
x-e-h2-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Halkii aad odhan lahayd 'waa hubaal,' ma isticmaashay heer kalsooni ku habboon xogta?
